verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a Mission Control Agent, so letting users plug MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. No evidence shows the agent or platform can connect to external MCP servers as a client. The Mission Control MCP server is the server role, which is a different capability and cannot be credited toward this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
